sources.title: Google Trends UK
sources.lookFor: Use Explore with a UK filter and record the terms, comparison window and geography. Treat the index as relative interest and allow for low-volume gaps.

sources.title: BBC News UK
sources.lookFor: Look for service questions raised by national and regional reporting. Trace significant claims to the named original records.

sources.title: UK Parliament committees
sources.lookFor: Check inquiries, hearing dates, oral and written evidence, reports and government responses. Match the service scope to the committee’s remit.

sources.title: UK Parliament developer hub
sources.lookFor: Use the Committees and Written Questions APIs for discovery where available. Open the underlying evidence or answer when qualifying a candidate.

sources.title: National Audit Office reports
sources.scope: UK government and bodies within the NAO remit
sources.lookFor: Look for delivery investigations, value-for-money studies and evidence about costs, handoffs and outcomes.

sources.title: GOV.UK research and statistics
sources.lookFor: Use filters for organisations, subject and publication date. Compare releases with their supporting datasets and revision notes.

sources.title: ONS release calendar
sources.lookFor: Find upcoming releases and revisions. Record the population, reporting date and release date separately.

sources.title: GOV.UK services and information
sources.lookFor: Find the real public entry point, eligibility, fees and what the reader should expect. Check which administration or council delivers it.

sources.title: Legislation.gov.uk
sources.lookFor: Check territorial extent, commencement orders and the version in force. Match legislation to current delivery guidance.

sources.title: Local Government and Social Care Ombudsman decisions
sources.lookFor: Find decisions and public-interest reports about local services. Use detail about the consequences and remedy in the case and seek wider data for prevalence.

sources.title: Housing Ombudsman decisions
sources.lookFor: Look for repair and complaint-handling failures, remedies and wider learning. Check landlord scope and what case-level evidence supports.

sources.title: Scottish Parliament committees
sources.lookFor: Check committee evidence, forward work, reports and follow-up correspondence on devolved services.

sources.title: Audit Scotland publications
sources.lookFor: Find audits of devolved and local services, report recommendations and any follow-up reviews.

sources.title: Scottish Government statistics and research
sources.lookFor: Use the statistical calendar and publisher releases, including Social Security Scotland and Public Health Scotland.

sources.title: Senedd Business
sources.lookFor: Find committee work, statements, Bills and transcripts. Track government responses and commencement separately.

sources.title: Audit Wales publications
sources.lookFor: Find national and council audits with comparable evidence, spending and follow-up.

sources.title: StatsWales
sources.lookFor: Find Welsh Government datasets and related releases. Check updates, revisions and differences in recording with the publisher.

sources.title: Northern Ireland Assembly committees
sources.lookFor: Look for minutes, reports, evidence and any actions committees asked the Executive to take.

sources.title: Northern Ireland Audit Office publications
sources.lookFor: Scan service reviews, the work programme and local government audit evidence.

sources.title: NISRA statistics
sources.lookFor: Find the responsible producer and current releases. For departmental services, follow through to the publisher’s release and methods.
